title: E61: no forecast required (not an R3b bank, §177)
statement: E61: no forecast required (not an R3b bank, §177). §177's D2/D3/D4 displays are not R3b banks; §181 R3b covers E56, E57, E59 and E62 only. This record is not a forecast and references no other bank's forecast.
purpose: The joint worker's capture-bound GO schema requires a 40-hex commit and sha256 in forecast_commits/forecast_seals for every captured experiment; for E61 those fields carry this record's commit and file sha256, as Guiv ruled.
